title: Macrophage lipid signaling drives glioblastoma invasion and represents a therapeutic vulnerability.
snippet: Glioblastoma (GBM) is characterized by diffuse infiltration into the surrounding brain, limiting complete surgical resection, the strongest determinant of patient survival. title: Integrative single-cell transcriptomic and metabolic profiling reveals lactate-driven glycolytic reprogramming and histone lactylation in colorectal cancer liver metastasis.
snippet: Metabolic reprogramming and immune evasion are hallmarks of cancer metastasis, but how tumor metabolism shapes the immune microenvironment during colorectal cancer (CRC) liver metastasis remains poorly understood. title: Spatial Proteomics Uncovers Immune Cell Neighborhoods and Tumor-Immune Interfaces in Pancreatic Ductal Adenocarcinoma.
snippet: Pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma (PDAC) remains one of the most lethal malignancies with dismal prognosis and limited treatment options. title: Premedication with Doxycycline Attenuates Early and Delayed LPS-Induced Neuroinflammation in Rats.
snippet: A systemic injection of lipopolysaccharide (LPS) induces a prolonged neuroinflammatory response, which is accompanied by microglial activation, neuronal damage, and movement disorders. title: Neuroinflammation in levodopa-induced dyskinesia in Parkinson's disease: current state of the art.
snippet: Levodopa-induced dyskinesia (LID) remains a major limitation of long-term dopaminergic therapy in Parkinson's disease (PD). title: Schwann cell reprogramming and immune regulation in the cancer microenvironment.
snippet: Schwann cells are peripheral glia with established roles in nerve support and repair. snippet: Critical-size craniofacial bone defects heal poorly, and pharmacological strategies capable of accelerating bone repair remain limited.
